items.title: Benny Waters interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995
items.q: >> [(note)] Benny was interviewed in Los Angeles, on September 1, 1995 by Michael Woods.

ctx.x: Benny Waters lays claim to be the oldest working jazzman in the country, probably in the world. Born in Maryland in 1902, Benny showed an early musical aptitude, giving piano recitals by age seven, and soon after learning the reed instruments from his older brother. He played in dance bands while still in high school and attended the Boston Conservatory of Music where he studied piano and theory while teaching clarinet. Benny was interviewed in Los Angeles, on September 1, 1995 by Michael Woods.
Hamilton College Jazz Archive are filming interviews with America’s greatest jazz musicians. We have here the elderstatesman of jazz, Benny Waters. Pleased to have you, Benny.
